title: do not be afraid

verses.text: Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My right hand of righteousness.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
Be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or terrified of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you; He will never leave you nor forsake you.”

caption:
When fear wakes you at three in the morning, you are not alone in the room.

Fear is not proof that your faith is small. It is the place where God says He is the one holding you up. Courage here is simply staying near the One who goes with you and does not leave.

Isaiah 41:10, Psalm 56:3, Deuteronomy 31:6 (BSB)
